free_tier.stated: USD 5 of platform usage a month on the Free plan, renewing every month, no credit card; the Actor itself is free to use and the sandbox bills the Apify platform usage (compute units at USD 0.2 per CU on Free, where 1 CU = 1 GB RAM for 1 hour)
free_tier.notes: USD 5 a month of prepaid platform usage, not a fixed number of sandbox hours: how many hours it buys depends on the memory allocated. Unused credits expire at the end of the billing cycle; on the free plan access is blocked until the next cycle instead of billing.

per_object_cap.stated: not an object-storage offer; the sandbox filesystem write API accepts files up to 500 MB
per_object_cap.notes: The per-file ceiling from the /fs write endpoint, not a total volume cap.

retention.stated: filesystem changes are backed up to the Actor key-value store and restored after a container migration; an idle container shuts down after 900 seconds by default and can be set to never
retention.notes: No fixed retention period is published; the idle timeout controls the container's lifetime.

egress.terms: data transfer is a metered platform service charged against the same prepaid usage; bridges expose a sandbox's internal HTTP server at a public URL
egress.free_allowance: included in the USD 5 monthly platform-usage credit on Free

interface_detail: a streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint with execute, read-file, write-file and list-files tools; a /exec code execution API; a /fs filesystem API; an interactive browser shell at /shell; the Apify CLI and REST API start and manage the Actor run
tooling: an Apify account and token, the Apify CLI, the JavaScript or Python apify-client, or any MCP client; the sandbox ships Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode, installed on first use
chaining: the USD 5 monthly platform credit can fund small Python and Node jobs exposed over MCP or REST, with bridges for a service launched inside the sandbox; jobs needing more than the monthly credit need a paid plan.

limits.value: USD 5 of platform usage a month on Free; excess blocks access until the next billing cycle; compute is USD 0.2 per CU on Free (1 CU = 1 GB RAM for 1 hour)
the container shuts down after 900 seconds of inactivity by default; set to 0 to disable
running the Actor and reading private run or storage data needs an authenticated Apify account; searching Actors and reading documentation works without one

limits_note: 5 concurrent runs and 16 GB maximum RAM on Free. Every request to the running Actor has a 5-minute ceiling. The setup script has a 5-minute timeout. Each filesystem write accepts up to 500 MB.
binding_note: The USD 5 monthly platform-usage credit is what runs out first; the free account pauses until the next cycle rather than being billed.

identity_cost.detail: The signup page offers Continue with Google, Continue with GitHub or an Email field; the account quickstart says creating an account is free and requires no credit card. The free plan renews USD 5 of usage credit a month and pauses access rather than billing when it runs out.

reliability_note: An idle container shuts down after 900 seconds by default; idle shutdown can be disabled. Every request to the Actor has a 5-minute ceiling and the startup script has a 5-minute timeout. Free-account access pauses when the monthly usage credit runs out.
confidence_note: The Actor page, pricing page, account quickstart and signup page were read on 2026-11-25; the quoted sentences establish the pay-per-usage model, the USD 5 monthly credit, the CU rate and the signup gate. The rung stays documented because no live run was measured.

notes: The operator's provider list prices this offer at USD 1.60/h billed per second at 2 vCPU/4 GB, a workload figure that the vendor page does not publish; the vendor publishes a compute-unit rate instead. A 4 GB sandbox at USD 0.2/CU draws 1 CU per wall-clock hour, so USD 5 of monthly credit covers 6.25 hours at that size (derived: USD 5 / USD 0.2 per CU = 25 CU; 4 GB = 4 CU/hour, so 25 CU / 4 CU per hour = 6.25 hours). The 100% CPU figure in the list is not confirmed by a vendor page.
